description: This is a Python script that sets up an audio processing pipeline involving speech recognition (STT), language model interaction, and text-to-speech (TTS). It initializes various services, configures a pipeline with input/output transports, and runs an asynchronous main function to execute the conversation flow.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Context object for managing conversation state with the language model.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Holds paired aggregators for user and assistant responses within the conversation context.

classes.name: LocalAudioTransport
classes.description: Handles local audio input/output transport mechanisms.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the audio pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with its parameters for execution.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Asynchronous main function initializing services, setting up the pipeline, and running the interaction loop.
